# Conference Travel Plan: 18th Rocky Mountain Instrumentation Conference

Traveler: Aya Nakamura, Research and Development

Trip period: from Monday, February 8, 2027 to Thursday, February 11, 2027

Venue: Colorado Convention Center, Denver

## Purpose

To present our results at the 18th Rocky Mountain Instrumentation Conference (Colorado Convention Center) and attend related sessions. The talk is in the afternoon session on Wednesday, February 9, 2027.

## Travel

| Leg | Flight | Departs | Arrives |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dallas → Denver | WN 1432 | Feb 8, 1:00 PM | Feb 8, 2:10 PM |
| Denver → Dallas | WN 1587 | Feb 11, 3:30 PM | Feb 11, 3:05 PM |

From Denver airport, the A Line train runs to Union Station in about 40 minutes. On February 8, I will meet my co-author Dr. Kobayashi at Union Station, Wynkoop Street entrance, at 2:30 PM to visit the venue.

## Hotel

I will stay four nights at the Larimer Square Hotel from Monday, February 8, 2027 to Thursday, February 11, 2027.
